CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story:.
   B. Use Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Story: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   D. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   B. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.
   C. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

13. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)

   B. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Easter Life of Jesus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
